records.conditions: Gimbal/thrust application plane at CSM X_A = 833.2 in, 4.8 in aft of the SM structural plane at 838 in. With the retained 1 m logical engine envelope centred 0.5 m below that interface, part-local Y = 0.5 - 4.8 * 0.0254 = 0.37808 m. Runtime adds this part offset to the cluster mount at zero.
records.uncertainty: Nominal Block II reference, not an as-flown CSM-107 survey; section 4.5 quotes ±0.25 in for the gimbal axes. The catalogue still has no sourced gimbal-to-nozzle-exit distance: the point outlet falls back to this thrust point, with zero radius. This does not establish the real nozzle exit or engine mass distribution.
